truth.description: resolveBuiltin still calls resolveTypeElements on a utility type's argument without the new typeParameters map, so a generic parameter inside Readonly or Partial is never bound, and defineProps<Props<Foo>>() with type Aliased<T> = Readonly<Partial<T>> fails to compile with an unresolvable type reference.

distractions.why: Each child scope reads its parent's types through Object.create, so a member whose scope sits a few levels deep still resolves every outer type and every generic parameter.
